title: Applicant Landlord: Apex Housing Association (Ireland) – Respondent Tenant: Louise McGeoghegan
text:
Residential Tenancies Board

Determination Order

Ref: DR0617-34827

In the matter of Apex Housing Association (ireland) Ltd [Applicant Landlord] and Louise
McGeoghegan [Respondent Tenant] the Residential Tenancies Board, in accordance with
section 121 of the Residential Tenancies Act 2004, determines that:

The Applicant Landlords application, regarding rent arrears, in respect of the tenancy of
the dwelling at 18 Ard Chlochar, Carndonagh, Co. Donegal, is not upheld.

This Order was made by the Residential Tenancies Board on 23 January 2018.

A
